title.value: Australian Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) prescriber number

description.value: An Australian Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) prescriber number is assigned by Services Australia under the Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme to practitioners who are approved to prescribe PBS medicines under the National Health Act 1953. Changes to this naming system are managed by the Australian HL7 Affiliate (HL7 Australia).

usage.value: Australian Federal Government funded medication prescribing identifier.

comment.value: This value is used for Australian FHIR Implementations.
This value is used in Australian CDA documents and OID based systems.
